lines.zh: 我吊在枝下，紫壳贴着叶脉。
lines.en: I hang from the twig, my purple shell along the vein.
No feet remain, only a thread.

lines.zh: 风把我推得左一下右一下。
lines.en: Wind pushes me left, then right.
I lean slightly toward the light.

lines.zh: 丛林的树冠替我挡了雨。
lines.en: The canopy takes the rain for me.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在下面的阔叶上。
lines.en: My shadow falls on a broad leaf below.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬上枝头，我晃。
lines.en: A beetle climbs the twig; I sway.
It pauses, then goes.
The purple deepens.
Sun slants in from the side.

lines.zh: 我朝叶缝里的光偏过去。
lines.en: I lean toward the light in the leaf gap.

lines.zh: 这是我唯一能做的动作。
lines.en: It is the only motion I have.

lines.zh: 壳的一端比另一端重，我总歪着。
lines.en: One end of me is heavier; I hang askew.
A new leaf unfurls on the vine.

lines.zh: 我旁边又多了一枚蛹，颜色不同。
lines.en: Another chrysalis hangs nearby, a different colour.
Neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我静得像一片卷起的叶。
lines.en: I am as still as a curled leaf.
A thin wax coats my shell.
Rain beads and rolls off.
It drops and strikes the leaf.
It is dark inside me.

lines.zh: 暗里有一团紫色的东西。
lines.en: In that dark, something purple.
It is slowly arranging itself.
I cannot see it, and I know it.
A bird calls in the jungle.
Near, then far.
I keep hanging.
I count the veins of the leaf.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整片盖住。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me entirely.

lines.zh: 我在叶子下面，颜色不太显。
lines.en: Under the leaf, my colour barely shows.
You search a long while.
A purple corner, flat against the leaf.

lines.zh: 你终于看见了紫色的一小块。
lines.en: At last you see a small patch of purple.
You reach out, then stop.
That is right.
It is still soft inside.
You draw your fingers back.
I stay where I am.
A fine line appears on my purple shell.

lines.zh: 被碰得转过去，又转回来。
lines.en: Knocked around, I swing back.
What is inside curls into a ball.

lines.zh: 我挂在丝上喘，如果我会喘的话。
lines.en: I hang panting, if I could pant.
This mark will not fade.
I can only bear it.
The leaf shade hides half of me.
It takes a long while to stop.
The pain sets the whole leaf shaking.
One more knock and the silk snaps.

lines.zh: 我不需要你手上的东西。
lines.en: I do not need what is in your hand.
The nectar is for the ones who can fly.
You hold a leaf beside me.

lines.zh: 我是从叶子上长起来的。
lines.en: I grew out of leaves.
Now I do not eat them.
Your hand stays raised.
Put it down.
The wind will take it.
I only need to hold on.
That is my only wish.
The twig dips when you touch it.

lines.zh: 我整个人往下滑了一寸。
lines.en: I slide down an inch.
The silk pulls taut.
I stop in midair.
You cup your hand beneath me.
Your palm is very warm.
Slowly I rise back.
The silk slackens.
You take your hand away.
I go on swaying.
The veins are still growing inside.

lines.zh: 紫色的翅膀还在里面折着。
lines.en: Purple wings still folded inside.
The shell isn't hard yet — wait.

lines.zh: 我听见外面有同类的翅声。
lines.en: I hear kin wings outside.
Very light, like paper on paper.
My purple wings are still folded.

lines.zh: 我还没到能回应的时候。
lines.en: I am not yet able to answer.
I will wait a while longer.
My shell is quiet.
That is just as well.
I am lifted with the leaf.
I spin once in the air.
The purple shell catches light.
Someone sets me by a window.
It is drier here than the jungle.
I am not used to it.
But I hold.
The window frame's grain is coarse.
I wait beneath it.
For what must happen.
Something has stopped beside me.
It neither moves nor leaves.
I feel its breath.

lines.zh: 我是紫色的，在绿叶上很显眼。
lines.en: I am purple, and show clearly on green.
That is the cost.
I have no way to hide.
I can only tighten my shell.
And tuck the purple into shadow.
It watches a long while.
Then walks away.
That shadow is still outside my leaf.

lines.zh: 我能听见它的脚步踩在落叶上。
lines.en: I hear it on the fallen leaves.
Each step is clear.
I press my shell tighter.

lines.zh: 里面的那团东西也在缩。
lines.en: The thing inside shrinks too.
We both wait for it to leave.
Wind leaks through the canopy.
It carries some sound away.
The steps recede.
I slowly loosen.

lines.zh: 我只能晃，晃给撞我的人看。
lines.en: All I can do is rock, and rock at whoever hit me.
It bends the twig.
I swing out and knock back into the twig.

lines.zh: 紫色的壳磕出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white mark on my purple shell.
I swing back, still rocking.
Its fingers flick at me.
I spin twice.
The silk snags its knuckle.
It shakes its hand.
I am still hanging.

lines.zh: 一片叶子的背面多了一点紫。
lines.en: A fleck of purple appears under a leaf.
That is me.

lines.zh: 我原本是一条绿色的毛虫。
lines.en: I was a green caterpillar once.
Now only this shell is left.

lines.zh: 丛林湿热，紫色的外面蒙着一层水汽。
lines.en: The jungle is damp; mist coats my purple.

lines.zh: 我挂得很低，几乎贴到叶脉。
lines.en: I hang low, nearly on the vein.
Ants walk the silk.
They do not bite.
I stay quiet.

lines.zh: 在这片绿里，我只有一点点颜色。
lines.en: In all this green, I have only a little colour.

lines.zh: 热气把紫色的壳烤出焦边。
lines.en: Heat scorches the rim of my purple shell.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，壳摔裂了。
lines.en: I fall from the twig and my shell splits.
Water climbs the silk; the purple darkens.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从叶子上撕开。
lines.en: The blast rips me from the leaf.
It grazes the edge of my shell.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进壳里，紫色淡了一层。
lines.en: Cold enters and my purple pales a shade.
At this stage I do not eat.

lines.zh: 雷光透过叶缝，紫壳亮得像玻璃。
lines.en: Lightning through the leaf gap; my shell glows like glass.

lines.zh: 没有叶子可挂，只有虚空。
lines.en: No leaf to hang from, only the void.
